negative_controls: Reject removal or reordering of a Lean theorem.
Reject a rehashed all-degree theorem claim.
Reject an S4 automorphism count other than 24 or any non-inner automorphism.
Reject a non-scalar ordinary centralizer or nonzero sign-twisted intertwiner.
Reject removal or mutation of the exceptional even-exponent Kummer relation.
Reject promotion of a uniform full Kummer-kernel claim.
Reject an A4 automorphism count other than 24 or a tetrahedral normalizer that does not preserve the coordinate axes.
Reject Lean sources containing sorry, admit, or an axiom declaration.
claim_boundary: The successor proves a coefficient-stratified all-m transport theorem in writing: it withdraws the false uniform full-kernel claim, detects the exceptional even-exponent relations, and reroutes that stratum by decomposition descent. Lean checks five coefficient-algebra statements, and a separate SymPy/Python implementation checks nineteen symbolic and finite-group consequences. Kummer theory, divisor valuations, the block-stabiliser lemma, decomposition descent, polynomial monodromy, Ritt theory, the complete all-degree classification, novelty, external independent reproduction, peer review, and publication are not formally verified or claimed.
